title: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm

texts.text_3: Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
texts.text_4: ...it will act according to its setting
texts.text_5: The value panel will allow you to configure it
texts.text_6: Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
texts.text_7: If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
texts.text_8: Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
texts.text_9: Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm

args.text: Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
...it will act according to its setting
The value panel will allow you to configure it
Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm
